summary: Follow cache hits, request routing, server rendering and revalidation.
scope: A product-level teaching flow based on Vercel documentation. Edge delivery and regional compute are separate; functions do not automatically run beside every visitor or every database.
author: Thoth

componentNotes.client: Requests static assets or a rendered page and submits actions.
componentNotes.edge: Serves cached responses and routes misses toward a regional deployment.
componentNotes.cache: Keeps a response available near the visitor for repeat reads.
componentNotes.routing: Chooses the regional function for dynamic requests.
componentNotes.render: Reads application data and produces the requested page.
componentNotes.db: Stores the data used by rendering and validated mutations.
componentNotes.assets: Provides static files independently of page rendering.
componentNotes.revalidate: Generates a fresh response and replaces the cached representation.
componentNotes.api: Validates dynamic actions and writes application changes.
